# The CAVLC and coded_block_pattern tables of ITU-T H.264 (V16, 06/2026),
# transcribed from the Recommendation's text: Table 9-5 (coeff_token),
# Tables 9-7, 9-8 and 9-9 (total_zeros), Table 9-10 (run_before) and
# Table 9-4 (a) (coded_block_pattern, ChromaArrayType 1 or 2).
#
# Extracted mechanically from `pdftotext -layout` of the PDF, then checked
# by tests/ip_h264_parse.rs: every VLC here is prefix-free, each one's
# Kraft sum is what its table's shape implies, and each cbp column is a
# permutation of 0..47. ip/video/h264_parse/tools/gen_vlc.py writes
# rtl/h264_vlc.v from this file.
#
# coeff_token <nC column> <TrailingOnes> <TotalCoeff> <code>
#   nC column: 0 (0 <= nC < 2), 2 (2 <= nC < 4), 4 (4 <= nC < 8),
#   8 (8 <= nC), -1 (nC == -1, chroma DC 4:2:0), -2 (nC == -2, 4:2:2)
# total_zeros<class> <tzVlcIndex> <total_zeros> <code>
#   class 16: 4x4 blocks (Tables 9-7, 9-8); 4: chroma DC 2x2; 8: chroma DC 2x4
# run_before <zerosLeft, with 7 meaning "> 6"> <run_before> <code>
# cbp_intra | cbp_inter <codeNum> <coded_block_pattern>
